name: Remote Desktop Web Consoles
description: Opens machines through your own Apache Guacamole or MeshCentral server from the devices console. You paste the console's page for a machine; the desktop app shows it in a separate browser view, and phones and the Web open it in a browser. Cognia stores no console password: the console signs you in and decides what you may do.

headless.reason: A console is a page someone looks at; a headless Host only keeps the binding for its paired devices (ADR-0234).

en.manifest.name: Remote Desktop Web Consoles
en.manifest.description: Opens machines through your own Apache Guacamole or MeshCentral server from the devices console. You paste the console's page for a machine; the desktop app shows it in a separate browser view, and phones and the Web open it in a browser. en.guacamole.name: Apache Guacamole
en.guacamole.description: A connection page of your Guacamole server (…/#/client/…). Reaches RDP, VNC and SSH machines behind it.
en.meshcentral.name: MeshCentral
en.meshcentral.description: A device page of your MeshCentral server (…?gotonode=…). Opens that device's desktop.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 远程桌面 Web 控制台
zh-CN.manifest.description: 在设备控制台中通过你自己的 Apache Guacamole 或 MeshCentral 服务器打开机器。粘贴控制台中某台机器的页面链接；桌面应用会在独立的浏览视图中显示，手机和网页则在浏览器中打开。Cognia 不保存控制台密码：由控制台负责登录和权限。
zh-CN.guacamole.name: Apache Guacamole
zh-CN.guacamole.description: 你的 Guacamole 服务器中的连接页面（…/#/client/…）。可访问其后的 RDP、VNC 和 SSH 机器。
zh-CN.meshcentral.name: MeshCentral
zh-CN.meshcentral.description: 你的 MeshCentral 服务器中的设备页面（…?gotonode=…）。打开该设备的桌面。
